1  JUDGMENT

The Police Sub-Inspector of City Market Police Station, Bengaluru has filed this charge sheet against the accused for the offences punishable U/Sec. 504 & 506 of IPC.
02.
The brief facts of the prosecution case are that, on 04.02.2020 at 10.00 am within the limits of City Market Police Station near Blue star club, CW.1 asked money to accused.
The accused has abused towards CW. 1 in filthy language and gave life threat to her.
Hence, CW.1 lodged first information.
The Station House Officer registered a case in Cr.No.40/2020 for the offences punishable U/Sec.498A, 504, 506, 420 of IPC and submitted First Information Report to this Court.
After investigation, Police Inspector of City market Police Station filed charge sheet for the said offences punishable U/Sec. 504 & 506 of IPC.
Hence, he has committed the alleged offences.
03. Accused is on bail.
On receipt of charge sheet, this court took the cognizance of the alleged offences and furnished copy of the prosecution papers to the accused persons.
After hearing on charge, this Court has framed charge for the offences punishable U/Sec. 504 & 506of IPC for which the accused pleaded not guilty and claimed to be tried.

04. The prosecution in order to prove its case, has examined 4 witnesses as PW.1 to PW.4 and five documents got marked as Ex.P.1 to Ex.P.5 and closed the side of the prosecution evidence, and Statements u/Sec.313 of Cr.P.C. recorded, read over and explained in the vernacular language of the accused, wherein accused has denied the incriminating circumstances appeared against him as false and did not choose to lead defence evidence.
As such, the matter was posted for arguments.
05. I have heard the arguments on both sides.

06. The points that arise for court consideration are as under:
(1) Whether the prosecution proves beyond reasonable doubt that, on 04.02.2020 at 10.00 am within the limits of City Market Police Station near Blue star club, CW.1 asked money to accused.
The accused has abused towards CW.
1 in filthy language and gave life threat to her and thereby committed an offences punishable U/Sec.
504 & 506 of IPC ?
2 ) What order ?
07.

My findings to the above points are as under:
Point No.1 : In the Negative, Point No.2 : As per final order, for the following:

sentences.text: 08 . Point No.1 :- It is well settled that in a criminal case the entire burden of proof rests upon the prosecution and the accused need to prove nothing.
Suffice for the accused to create doubt about the case of the prosecution and the reliability of the witnesses for the prosecution.
09. The main allegation of the prosecution is that on, on 04.02.2020 at 10.00 am within the limits of City Market Police Station near Blue star club, CW.1 asked money to accused.
The accused has abused towards CW. 1 in filthy language and gave life threat to her.

As already stated supra, the prosecution has examined 4 witnesses as PW.1 to PW.4 and documents got marked as Ex.P.1 to Ex.P.5.
10.
The prosecution has been examined CW.7 as PW.1, he being Police Officer.

It is specifically testified before the court that, on 19.02.2020 when he was on station house officer duty, CW.1 came and gave written complaint, he received, verified and registered criminal case in Crime 40/2020 and he prepared FIR and original copy of FIR submitted before Hon'ble trial court and copy of FIR forwarded to his Senior Police Officers.
Further, he deposed before the court that, on same day he proceed with CW.1 to 3 to the place of alleged incident and conducted spot panchanama in the presence of CW.1 to 3.
Further, he deposed before the court that, on the same day CW.6 has produced accused before him, he arrested and enquired him and produced accused before Hon'ble court on 20.02.2020.
Further, he deposed before the court that, he recorded statements of CW.3 & 4 and he submitted charge sheet against accused .

Further, it is relevant to note that, on 18.08.2022,
the counsel for accused absent before this court.
Therefore, cross examination of PW.1 taken as nil.
11. The prosecution has been examined CW.6 as PW.2, he being Police Officer.

He specifically testified before this Court that, on 19.02.2020 as per the oral order of CW.7 , he had been to search accused and produced before CW.7 and gave his report before CW.7 and he identified his signature found in Ex.P.5.
Further, it is relevant to note that, on 18.08.2022, the counsel for accused absent before this court.

Therefore, cross examination of PW.2 taken as nil.
12.
The prosecution has been examined CW.4 as PW.3.
She being mother of CW.1.
She specifically testified before the court that, CW.1 is her daughter, accused is her son-in-law.
The marriage of CW.1 and accused solemnized in the year May 2000 as per their customs at Muniswamappa Kalyana Mantapa, Yeshawanthapura, Bengaluru.
She made expense of Rs.11,00,000/- for the said marriage.
After the marriage, CW.1 had live with accused and they have two male children.

Further,
she deposed before the court that, CW. 1 and accused have made galata with mother of accused and started to lived with CW.1's house from 2003 till 2016.

The accused from the beginning of marriage,
has sustained loss in his business and accused has in financial loss, therefore he sold all the ornaments of CW.1.
The accused has running Blue Star Club in Balepete, Bengaluru.

Further, she deposed before the court that, the accused has received money by saying the Police Officers have raided their club, so he needs to pay money to Police Officers and he get all the gold ornaments of CW.1 and sold in market.
Some of gold ornaments of CW.1 pledged by accused.
Further, she deposed before the court that, her husband had working in BMTC conductor and he retired in the year 2014 and he got Rs.11,00,000/- from his retirement benefits.
The said retirement benefit amount of Rs.11,00,000/- taken by accused.

Further, she deposed before the court that, on 04.02.2020 at 10.00 am within the limits of City Market Police Station near Blue star club, CW.1 Vinutha vs T. K. Raju on 12 March, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/104194494/
3 asked money to accused.

sentences.text: The accused has abused towards CW. 1 in filthy language and gave life threat to her.
Therefore, CW.1 has lodged complaint against accused in City Market Police Station and she gave her statement before Police Officers.
Further, it is relevant to note that, on 09.12.2022,
the counsel for accused absent before this court.

Therefore, cross examination of PW.3 taken as nil.
13.
The prosecution has been examined CW.1 as PW.4.
She specifically testified before the court that, she married accused on 12.05.2000.
At the time of marriage they gave Rs.5,00,000/- , 800 gms gold, 8 kg Silver and they spent morethan Rs.15,00,000/- for the expense of marriage.
She had been lived with accused happily for a period of 4 years and they have two male children.
The accused has lived with his mother, sister and brother.

Further, she deposed before the court that, from the beginning of marriage, the accused has not looking her in proper manner and always demanded money from her, she pledged her gold ornaments and gave money to accused.
The accused had running re-creation club, it is in loss.
Further, she deposed before the court that, if CW.1 has not gave any money to accused, he pickedup galata and thrown out from his house and the accused has not provided any food to CW.1.
Further, she deposed before the court that, accused and CW.1 have been stayed in the parents house of CW.1 from 2004 to till 2016.
Further, she deposed before the court that, accused always demanded money from her parents.
Further, she deposed before the court that, in the year 2016, her father got perkins and accused made galata and took children and left the house.
Further, she deposed before the court that, if she went to see her children, accused picked galata with her and assaulted and called police and thrown out from house .
Therefore, she lodged FIS as per Ex.P.1 and Police Officers came and drawn spot panchanama as per Ex.P.3 and she requested to pay back money from accused.

Further, it is relevant to note that, on 05.08.2023,
the counsel for accused absent before this court.
Therefore, cross examination of PW.4 taken as nil.

14. On perusal of oral and documentary evidence placed by the prosecution it appears that, CW.7 is Investigation Officer of this case and CW.6 Police Officer and he apprehended accused and produced before CW.7.
CW.4 is mother of CW.1 and CW.1 is informant of this case.
They have been examined before this court as PW. 1 to 4 on 18.08.2022, 09.12.2022, 05.08.2023.

Further, it is relevant to note that, on 16.08.2023 after recording 313 statement of accused, the accused has filed application under section 311 Cr.P.C., to recall PW.1 to 4 for the purpose of cross examination.

The said application allowed by imposing cost of Rs.2,000/- and accused has complied order dated 16.05.2023 and this court issued process of summons, witness warrant and proclamation to PW. 1 to 4 through local and Senior Police Officers.
Despite that, the prosecution has not secured the presence of PW.1 to 4.
Therefore, this court took the prayer of Learned Senior APP rejected and PW.1 to 4 evidence discarded as not tender for cross examination on 16.12.2023.

Further, it is relevant to note that, when matter stood for arguments, the Learned Senior APP has filed application under section 311 Cr.P.C., to recall PW. 1 to 4 for the purpose of cross examination.
The said application came to be rejected on 23.01.2024.
So, there is no any incriminating evidence appears against accused.

Further, it is relevant to note that, despite took coercive steps against CW.2, 3, 5, the prosecution has failed to secure their presence before this court well in time and this court took prayer of Learned Senior APP rejected and CW.2, 3, 5 are dropped out vide order dated 05.08.2023.

The prosecution has not examined any indepandant witness to prove the allegations made in the complaint and moreover the order passed by this court dated 23.01.2024 is not yet challenged by prosecution and its attained finality, under this circumstances, there is no any Vinutha vs T. K. Raju on 12 March, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/104194494/
4 incriminating evidence appears against accused.
Therefore, this court clearly came to conclusion that, the prosecution has failed to prove the guilt beyond the reasonable doubt.
Accordingly, I answer Point No.1 in the Negative.

15. Point No.2 : For the aforesaid reasons, I proceed to pass the following:
ORDER Acting under Section 248(1) of Cr.P.C., accused is hereby acquitted of the offences punishable U/Sec. 504, 506 of IPC.
The bail bond and surety bond executed by accused shall continue for a period of two months from the date of this order and thereafter same shall stands canceled automatically.
(Dictated to the stenographer directly on computer, corrected directly on computer and then pronounced by me in the open court on this the 12 th day of March 2024).
(R.Mahesha) IX Addl.Chief Metropolitan Magistrate, Bengaluru.
